notes.title: Now available for Mac!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added support for Apple silicone Macs.
[*] Some back end changes to make future updates easier
[*] Prettier buttons and check boxes in the settings page
[/list]

notes.title: Release notes - v1.2.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added option to choose either male or female voices.
[*] Fixed the pronunciation of a couple of words.
[*] Tips now stop showing up after you've played the game a few times.
[/list]

notes.title: Release notes - v1.1.0
notes.content: Added two additional Chinese fonts you can choose from, Noto Sans and Noto Serif.
